name: Karato Market
description: Karato Market is Shimonoseki's central fish market, whose Iki-iki Bakangai street stalls sell sushi and seafood boxes directly to visitors, a highlight of the city's fugu (blowfish) culture. The wholesale area operates from early morning on weekdays, while the Bakangai food stalls run on Fridays, weekends and public holidays.
highlights: Iki-iki Bakangai fresh sushi stalls (Fri–Sun & holidays)
Working wholesale market atmosphere from early morning

ja.name: 唐戸市場
ja.description: 唐戸市場は下関市の中央卸売市場で、旬の魚介を使った寿司や海鮮丼をその場で味わえる「活きいき馬関街」が名物です。ふぐの街・下関の食文化を代表するスポットで、週末・祝日には鮮度抜群の寿司が並びます。
highlights: 「活きいき馬関街」の新鮮な寿司（金・土・日祝）
早朝から活気づく市場
